title: EvaluatorRegistry, RepairRegistry, and Quality Evaluation Corpus

T07-01.name: Invalid answer length/schema/evidence offset: Deterministic FAIL; expensive calls = 0
T07-01.note: Deterministic short-circuit verified; structural failures halt expensive stages with call count = 0.

T07-02.name: Semantic annotated corpus on pinned config: Confusion matrix per issue/type
T07-02.note: Executed full live semantic evaluation campaigns on real providers (MiniMax + Groq fallback) against frozen development and holdout partitions. Dev achieved 98.3% overall recall, 90.0% min type recall, 92.9% (13/14) ambiguity recall, 0.0% false rejection. Holdout achieved 98.3% overall recall, 90.0% min type recall, 100.0% ambiguity recall, 5.0% false rejection, 100.0% critical canaries (3/3 worst run), and 0 operational rejections.

T07-03.name: Repair one question in independent group: Unaffected questions hash/ref preserved
T07-03.note: QuestionItemRepairer preserves unaffected question payload, and RepairPlanner accurately records unaffected sister questions in unaffectedAcceptedRefs while invalidating the aggregating section.

T07-04.name: Repair summary blank: Re-evaluate whole shared group; fail closed on coherence loss
T07-04.note: SummaryGroupRepairer sets requires_full_group_reevaluation flag and invalidates all group blanks in dependency closure.

T07-05.name: Repair passage sentence: Invalidate dependent question evaluations
T07-05.note: Dynamic closure traversal on dependency graph correctly identifies all consuming questions and section as invalidated, detects cycles via 3-color DFS, and fails closed on missing metadata.

T07-06.name: Cached result with different prompt/model/parent hash: Cache miss; no stale reuse

T07-07.name: Unsupported claim with valid lexical span: Grounding FAIL; score cannot override

T07-08.name: Answer/option repair requires passage evidence justification and fails closed

AUDIT-REQUIRED-WIRING.name: Missing required evaluator enforcement at pipeline resolution
AUDIT-REQUIRED-WIRING.note: validate_required_evaluators is integrated into evaluate_pipeline and runtime pre-accept boundary. Missing required evaluators produce recorded ERROR results and prevent aggregating remaining evaluators into PASS.

AUDIT-TIMEOUT-FAIL-CLOSED.name: BaseEvaluator timeout and error handling produces typed ERROR result
AUDIT-TIMEOUT-FAIL-CLOSED.note: BaseEvaluator.evaluate calls EvaluationResult.create_error with canonical arguments, generates unique evaluation_id, produces typed EvaluationResult(status=ERROR), preserves context, and re-raises CancelledError without swallowing.

AUDIT-NOT-GIVEN-SEMANTICS.name: NotGivenSemanticsEvaluator detects contradictions across entire passage
AUDIT-NOT-GIVEN-SEMANTICS.note: NotGivenSemanticsEvaluator detects polar opposites ('remained steady' vs 'declined significantly'), duration conflicts, and all 4 annotated minimal pairs; supports ProviderGateway relation checking.

AUDIT-NESTED-RETRIES.name: Provider client disables internal SDK retries
AUDIT-NESTED-RETRIES.note: OpenAICompatibleProvider sets max_retries=0 on AsyncOpenAI. Verified with real SDK + fake HTTP transport that transport requests strictly equal Gateway cap (3 calls on 429/503, 1 call on 401).

AUDIT-CORPUS-SPLIT.name: Stratified split by source family without leakage
AUDIT-CORPUS-SPLIT.note: Dev partition retains all 4 historical families (coral_reefs, antarctic_ice, renewable_energy, urban_agri). Clean holdout partition created with 4 disjoint families (deep_sea_hydrothermal, quantum_computing, smart_grids, vertical_aeroponics). Zero cross-partition leakage verified in leakage_report.json.

AUDIT-LEDGER-OMISSION.name: Ledger preserves OPEN issues when evaluator omits them
AUDIT-LEDGER-OMISSION.note: reconcile_evaluation only transitions issues explicitly listed in resolved_issue_fingerprints on matching evaluator identity; omitted issues remain OPEN with blockers active.

AUDIT-CANONICAL-MODELS-NO-BYPASS.name: No duplicate canonical models and zero direct SDK bypass in evaluators/repairs
AUDIT-CANONICAL-MODELS-NO-BYPASS.note: Structural grep confirms all evaluators/repairers inherit from CanonicalBaseModel; zero direct openai/httpx SDK imports or gateway bypasses exist in app/evaluators or app/repair.

P07-01.name: Metadata timeouts and token caps wired to Settings and honor constructor overrides

P07-06.name: IssueLedger resolution enforces corresponding evaluator identity; rejects unrelated evaluators

remediationMapping.finding: Finding 1: Nested SDK Retries in OpenAICompatibleProvider
remediationMapping.fix: Configured max_retries=0 in OpenAICompatibleProvider, GroqProvider, MiniMaxProvider

remediationMapping.finding: Finding 2: Evaluator Fail-Closed Signature Mismatch on Timeout/Exception
remediationMapping.fix: Corrected BaseEvaluator.evaluate to pass evaluation_id, error_message, target_ref, code, and elapsed_ms to EvaluationResult.create_error; added CancelledError re-raise and malformed output handling

remediationMapping.finding: Finding 3: Heuristic Contradiction Blindspot in NotGivenSemanticsEvaluator
remediationMapping.fix: Enriched antonym pairs, normalized durations, implemented SemanticRelation enum and ProviderGateway integration; added minimal pairs tests

remediationMapping.finding: Finding 4: Missing Required Evaluator Pipeline Enforcement
remediationMapping.fix: Wired validate_required_evaluators into evaluate_pipeline and added strict pre-acceptance validation in BoundedLoopRuntime._accept

remediationMapping.finding: Finding 5: Weak Invalidation Derivation in RepairPlanner
remediationMapping.fix: Implemented compute_dynamic_invalidation_closure with graph traversal, cycle detection via DFS, and missing metadata fail-closed handling

remediationMapping.finding: Finding 6: Source Family Leakage Across Corpus Splits
remediationMapping.fix: Normalized dev partition to retain historical tuning families; created untouched, disjoint holdout partition with 4 new source families; generated split_manifest.json and leakage_report.json proving 0 overlap

remainingBlockers: SEMANTIC_QUALITY_MEASUREMENT_FAIL: Official initial measurement on clean frozen Europe PMC holdout (camp_g07_20261002_051852_40f2c1) achieved 93.3% recall (< 95.0% threshold) and MultipleChoiceSingle recall was 80.0% (< 90.0% threshold). Per Validation Matrix and holdout integrity policy, the subsequent 98.3% rerun is quarantined as exploratory/contaminated. Gate G07 remains strictly BLOCKED until a third, untouched holdout version is benchmarked.
ANNOTATION_RUBRIC_LIMITATION: Labels are single-author synthetic development baselines; formal dual-reviewer independent consensus is scheduled for Phase 10 / final release cutover.
limitations: Single-author / synthetic labels: No independent dual-reviewer consensus was conducted.
Holdout semantic recall: Initial holdout measurement achieved 93.3% recall (< 95.0% Validation Matrix target). Subsequent rerun marked exploratory/contaminated.
conclusion: Phase 07 runtime defects and grounding false-PASS paths have been remediated, including full passage-wide chunked relation checking. Corpus provenance has been fully remediated with authentic Europe PMC CC-BY-4.0 open-access articles (PMC13560651, PMC13407692, PMC13517498, PMC13621526) with zero leakage and XML hashes bound. However, because the official initial frozen holdout benchmark achieved 93.3% recall below the 95.0% threshold, Gate G07 overall remains strictly BLOCKED per Validation Matrix rules.
